source: kenyanstocks.com financial statements API (farmed, complete) | CRON 2026-11-12: H1 2026 balance sheet column added and the FY2025 balance column filled from the unaudited interim results for the period ended 30 June 2026. Express Kenya Plc unaudited results for the six months ended 30 June 2026, consolidated statement of financial position, NSE filing library https://www.nse.co.ke/wp-content/uploads/Express-Kenya-Plc-%E2%80%93-Unaudited-Financial-Results-for-the-Period-Ended-30-June-2026.pdf . Printed in Shs thousands, stored as absolute KES. As at 30 June 2026: non-current assets 1,376,464 (property plant and equipment 275,592, right-of-use assets 1,019,679, investment property 81,193); current assets 228,440 (inventories 28,752, trade and other receivables 168,176, cash 133, tax recoverable 31,379, assets held for sale 0); total assets 1,604,904; non-current liabilities 773,851 (borrowings 314,990, lease liabilities 46,166, deferred tax 412,695); current liabilities 116,287 (lease liabilities 1,889, trade and other payables 114,398); total liabilities 890,138; shareholders funds 714,766. Ties: 773,851 + 116,287 + 714,766 = 1,604,904. The 1,488,617 printed in the filing is capital employed (equity plus non-current liabilities), not total assets, so total assets is the sum of non-current and current assets. The 31 December 2025 comparative column is filled from the same statement: non-current assets 1,391,290, current assets 77,681, total assets 1,468,971, non-current liabilities 905,763, current liabilities 91,023, total liabilities 996,786, shareholders funds 472,185 (1,468,971 ties to 996,786 + 472,185).

corrections_note: NSE source-certified balance row. This period's total-equity row is added from the dated source named in `corrections`, so the P/B stands on the period the valuation names instead of on an older year's book value under a current label. Every other row is left blank for this period: the source publishes the equity alone here, and a blank is honest where a guessed asset or liability is not. Carried in bot/statements.py (NSE_SOURCE_CERTIFIED) as well.
